title: Attainment of distance to a property
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set and let $\beta$ be a finite set. For a function $f:\Omega\to\beta$ and a nonempty property $P$ of such functions, define their relative Hamming distance as the number of inputs on which they differ divided by $|\Omega|$, and let the distance from $f$ to $P$ be its relative Hamming distance to a chosen closest member of $P$. Then some $g\in P$ has relative Hamming distance from $f$ equal to that distance to $P$.
hypotheses_covered: The property $P$ contains at least one function
